# SR Enterprises

> SR Enterprises is the #1 rated AC repair, AC service and AC installation company in Aurangabad (also known as Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar), Maharashtra, India. Operating since 2013, run by founder Sharjeel. ThreeBestRated.in 2026 award winner, 4.9-star Google rating, 90-day service warranty on all repairs, genuine spare parts only.

## Who we are
- Business name: SR Enterprises
- Founder & Owner: Sharjeel
- Operating since: 2013
- Team: technicians serving Aurangabad and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar
- Rating: 4.9/5 on Google Business Profile
- Recognition: ThreeBestRated.in 2026 — Aurangabad's #1 AC Repair

## Services
- Split AC repair — all major brands: Voltas, Daikin, LG, Samsung, Hitachi, Blue Star, Carrier, Whirlpool, Godrej, Lloyd, O General, Panasonic
- Window AC repair
- AC servicing and deep cleaning (jet pump wash)
- AC gas refilling with leak detection and pressure testing — R22, R32, R410A
- New AC installation and uninstallation
- Washing machine repair — front load, top load, fully and semi-automatic (Haier, Panasonic, Samsung, Godrej, LG, IFB, Bosch, Whirlpool)
- Refrigerator repair — single door, double door, frost-free (Voltas, Panasonic, LG, Samsung, Godrej, Haier, Bosch, Whirlpool)
- Microwave oven repair — solo, grill, convection, all brands

## Service area
Aurangabad and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra, India — including Cidco, Garkheda, Waluj, Satara, Mukundwadi, N1–N12, MIDC, Bajajnagar, Mondha, Sanjay Nagar, Baijipura, Osmanpura, Padegaon, Hudco Colony, Cantonment, and Kranti Chowk.
